lane.name: Replenish
lane.description: Replenish one triggered reorder rule: confirm the product and quantity, draft the purchase order, get the Warehouse Manager's approval, and submit the order. One run per reorder rule. A rejected draft stays a draft.

fields.description: Quantity to order, confirmed at step 1.1. Defaults to the rule's reorder_qty.
Supplier for the draft purchase order, confirmed at step 1.1. The rule names the product, not the supplier - the manager confirms which supplier to order from.
Why the draft purchase order is rejected, entered at step 3.2.

steps.name: Confirm the rule
steps.description: Confirm the product, the reorder level and the quantity to order. RR-04 is HG-1004, level 12, reorder 24. The Inventory Agent proposes the quantity and the supplier; the manager confirms or changes them.

steps.name: Check the rule is still triggered
steps.description: Automatic check: the rule is still triggered. If another run already replenished it, this run ends without ordering twice.

check.message: This rule is no longer triggered - another run may have replenished it.

steps.name: Create the draft PO
steps.description: Create the draft purchase order for the rule's product, the confirmed quantity, from the confirmed supplier, as DRAFT. The next PO number is assigned (PO-2026-013 follows the seed's twelve). The draft is not sent to the supplier until the manager approves it.

steps.name: Review the draft
steps.description: Review the draft purchase order - supplier, product, quantity and total - before it goes to the manager for approval.

steps.name: Approve the draft PO
steps.description: The Warehouse Manager approves the draft purchase order for submission. Approve: the order is submitted (OPEN) and sent to the supplier. Reject: the draft stays a draft and the run goes to the hold step.

steps.name: Record hold
steps.description: Record why the draft is rejected. Completing this step ends the run as held. The draft purchase order stays DRAFT; nothing is submitted to the supplier.

steps.name: Confirm the submission
steps.description: The purchase order is submitted (OPEN) and the run is done. The rule stays triggered until the goods arrive and the stock is received - the lane does not clear it.
